entities.summary: Cyril Collard was a French author, filmmaker, composer, musician and actor. He is known for his unapologetic portrayals of bisexuality and HIV in art, particularly his autobiographical novel and film Les Nuits fauves. Openly bisexual, Collard was also one of the first French artists to speak openly about his HIV-positive status.
